source: Current project Expanded CRD, with original printed references read before modernizing.

general_rules.energy: Default cost 2 stages, damage 4 life cards; explicit plus damage supplements base.
general_rules.physical: AT unless fixed damage is printed.
general_rules.conditional_effects: HIT effects kept distinct from independent effects; final self-banish remains unconditional.
general_rules.type_migration: Event, Setup, Drill; broad Non-Combat means Setup or Drill; Combat timing retained.
general_rules.dense_text: Card 99 uses established MP and MPPV abbreviations at the unchanged native size to fit five rows. Full corrected effects and CRD rulings are retained here.
